summary: Frontend smoke + flow test of Collaboration & Knowledge Marketplace Epic (Phases B2..F) via the public preview URL. Logged in as super@test.com (Organization Login) and validated every requested screen: /marketplace, /public-help, /earnings, /leaderboard, /fame/{id}, /admin/platform-experts (incl. Add Expert form + JSON Bulk modal), /admin/payouts (incl. Run payouts now confirmation), /admin/karma (incl. Save). 13/13 frontend checks passed. The ShareStepModal Experts tab was NOT exercised end-to-end (requires drilling into a specific decision step with a Share action — deep nav), but the underlying data is verified (3 seeded experts visible on /admin/platform-experts and backend covered in iter146).

minor.issue: Returns 404 on every page load (frontend bootstrap hits it). Pre-existing — unrelated to this epic — but worth fixing or removing the call to avoid noise in console / hardening logs.

issues: Header '+', cloud-upload and back icons have NO testID on TouchableOpacity. Tests/regression had to click by coordinate. Add testID='open-add-expert', testID='open-bulk-upload' for stable selectors.
'Run payouts now' button and 'Save configuration' button have no testID — works today via visible text but adding testIDs would harden tests.
'Save configuration' button and per-event TextInputs have no testID.

Tapping the demo top-rank row navigates to /fame/user_fake which renders a placeholder ('Member' / 400 KP / 0 ratings). If 'user_fake' is a real user_id, fine — but if it is a literal demo string, real fame lookups will look broken to users. Verify the leaderboard endpoint isn't returning seeded fake ids.

react_native_issues.issue: Web preview console emits 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' on every screen. Migrate shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius to boxShadow for web parity (still ok on native).

Console: '[expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web. Adding a listener will have no effect.' — expected on web preview, no action needed unless web is target.

action_items: Add testID attributes on /admin/platform-experts header buttons (open-add-expert, open-bulk-upload), Add Expert form Save button, and on /admin/payouts (run-payouts-now, save-config) + /admin/karma (save-config) for stable e2e selectors.
Investigate /api/acm/health 404 — either implement or remove the frontend probe to clean up console.
Migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow across LinearGradient/cards to silence RN web deprecation warnings.
Verify the /api/karma/leaderboard endpoint isn't returning a synthetic 'user_fake' id — if it is, replace with real seed user ids so /fame/{id} renders a real profile.
(Optional, not tested by me) End-to-end exercise the ShareStepModal Experts tab on a real decision step to confirm the 3 seeded platform experts appear and 'Ask the public for help' submits.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/marketplace.tsx L29 loadRazorpayScript references document/window directly — guarded by Platform.OS==='web' at call-site, but the function itself is unconditional. If ever called from native it will throw — add an early return when Platform.OS !== 'web'.

/app/frontend/app/marketplace.tsx L114 buyClone catches errors but the busy flag is reset on a 1000ms timer rather than awaiting rzp.open(); if Razorpay script load fails after the catch returns, busy will still toggle off — fine, but means double-clicks during the 1s window could fire 2nd order. Consider a dedicated 'rzpOpen' flag.
/app/frontend/app/public-help.tsx is 388 lines — getting close to the 700-line guideline, OK but a refactor splitting the Detail modal into its own component would help.
/app/frontend/app/leaderboard.tsx L113 routes to /fame/${u.user_id} cast as 'any' — Expo Router type is wider than that; consider declaring the route type so type-checking catches stale ids.
/app/frontend/app/admin/platform-experts.tsx does not surface success/error toasts on Add Expert save — would be a UX improvement (currently relies on modal close).
